name: long-read sequencing, assemblers and polishers benchmark (yeast)
description: Benchmarks long-read sequencing technologies, genome assemblers, and polishers on yeast to evaluate assembly contiguity, consensus accuracy, and error profiles.
reputation: Widely used in the genomics/bioinformatics community for method comparisons on long-read assemblers and polishers for small eukaryotic genomes (yeast).
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on yeast; results are technology- and coverage-dependent and may not generalize to larger or more repetitive genomes. Dataset sizes are relatively small and benchmarking can be sensitive to contamination and parameter choices.
